properties.title: EyeWorld: A Generative World Model of Ocular State and Dynamics

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Retrospective evaluation of a multimodal generative ophthalmic model on parsing, detection, translation, enhancement and longitudinal OCT prediction against four fine-tuned general image-editing baselines.
properties.independent_study_claim: single group; public datasets plus private tertiary-centre data

properties.description: Multimodal transformer for text and ViT tokens, VAE structural latent, and a diffusion decoder fine-tuned from the OmniGen2 backbone with prompt-selected projections.
properties.world_model_status: generative imaging model with time-conditioned forecasting, supporting component

properties.algorithm: EyeWorld supervised fine-tuning of OmniGen2 with curriculum and hard-example mining
properties.world_model_status: supporting component (not_world_model; single-step time-conditioned image forecasting only)

properties.population: ophthalmic imaging cohorts (CFP, OCT, angiography, MRI)
properties.decision: image parsing, modality completion, enhancement and prognosis-oriented simulation under human oversight

relation_assertions.rationale: Single-step conditional forecasting of a follow-up OCT image is evaluated against the realized follow-up, within a multitask generative imaging model. No action port, multistep rollout or policy exists.

Reviewer mapping: a learned diffusion decoder conditioned on a baseline image, text and interval is a dynamics adapter. M3 and M7 are not mapped because the latent state is not carried across visits and no effect layer exists.

capability_assessments.rationale: Core world-model identity (V11) is not met: EyeWorld (fine-tuned OmniGen2) maps a single baseline image and natural-language interval prompt to a single follow-up image in one forward pass (Eq. 1-3, p.29) without carrying a persistent evolving state across successive prediction steps or multiple visits (state.persistent is partial). Accordingly, capability is honestly classified as not_world_model (supporting generative imaging/forecasting component), although single-step time-conditioned follow-up OCT prediction is scored against realized follow-up scans.

Accordingly, capability is honestly classified as not_world_model (supporting generative imaging/forecasting component), although single-step time-conditioned follow-up OCT prediction is scored against realized follow-up scans.

gate_assessments.rationale: Patient-level splits and de-identified data are described, but private data lack versions, the split used for hard-example mining is not stated, public sources may overlap, and the origin of RPE masks at test time is not stated.

Downgraded to unresolved: G02 requires state.persistent, dynamics.temporal, and rollout.one_step_evaluated at evaluation stage with a non-leaky reference. While single-step time-conditioned follow-up OCT scans are scored against realized scans versus four fine-tuned image-editing baselines, state.persistent is only partial (specification stage; single-step advance only), no copy-forward persistence baseline is reported, and test-time provenance of the macular-hole RPE alignment mask is unspecified.

legacy_cells.B: EyeWorld: A Generative World Model of Ocular State and Dynamics
legacy_cells.C: Gao, Ziyu, Wu, Xinyuan, Chen, Xiaolan, Liu, Zhuoran, Chen, Ruoyu, Liu, Bowen, et al.
legacy_cells.O: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) and macular hole
legacy_cells.S: What retinal structural changes will be generated at a specified follow-up interval from baseline OCT for AMD or postoperative macular hole?
legacy_cells.T: Longitudinal OCT cohorts with AMD and macular hole, including a post-vitrectomy macular-hole cohort; AMD forecasts use baseline OCT, age, sex, and follow-up interval.
legacy_cells.AI: CFP; OCT; FFA; ICGA; MRI; AF; UWF; free-form text prompts
legacy_cells.AJ: A multimodal transformer processes interleaved text tokens and ViT-encoded visual tokens; a variational image tokenizer (VAE encoder) produces a structural latent.
legacy_cells.AK: OmniGen2 backbone (publicly released multimodal generative checkpoint)
legacy_cells.AM: Interleaved text and ViT visual tokens are processed by a multimodal transformer to form semantic conditioning; a parallel VAE image latent supplies structural conditioning, combined as the latent ocular state.
legacy_cells.BN: RPE-based alignment prior for postoperative macular-hole OCT; the RPE mask is used as a positional alignment input.
legacy_cells.BS: Generated ophthalmic images, including segmentation/parsing outputs, cross-modality translations, quality-enhanced/completed images, and longitudinal OCT follow-up predictions.
legacy_cells.BT: Shared generative projection supports segmentation, lesion/structure detection, cross-modality translation, image-quality enhancement/completion, and longitudinal progression prediction.
legacy_cells.CA: Experiments used an NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB GPU cluster; effective batch size 64 across two NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB GPUs.
legacy_cells.DN: PALM; IDRiD; MESSIDOR; MMAC; OIMHS; ODIR-5k; OphthalWeChat; APTOS-2024; MARIO; private datasets
legacy_cells.DQ: 108,672 images; 85,638 image-mask pairs; 31,179 paired translation samples; 16,645 longitudinal examinations.
legacy_cells.DX: Across longitudinal prediction tasks, mean LPIPS 0.371, SSIM 0.651, and PSNR 21.462; reported as exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.3%, 6.1%, and 2.278, respectively.
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with Step1X-Edit, ChronoEdit, OmniGen2, and Qwen-Image; EyeWorld achieved mean Dice 0.77 versus 0.52, 0.61, 0.64, and 0.69, respectively, across segmentation tasks.
legacy_cells.EL: Authors report class imbalance remains challenging; progression prediction is limited to OCT cohorts and specific diseases; generated changes may be unsupported by input evidence in ambiguous, rare, or underspecified counterfactual cases.
legacy_cells.EO: Clinical images are described as de-identified; the study reports retrospective analysis of anonymized ophthalmic images and public datasets.
legacy_cells.ER: Hong Kong Polytechnic University Institutional Review Board approval HSEARS20240202004; informed consent waived because the analysis was retrospective and used anonymized ophthalmic images and public datasets.
legacy_cells.FB: State S_t is a paired semantic and structural latent: c_sem from multimodal text/vision conditioning and z_struc from the VAE image encoder, representing task semantics and patient-specific ocular structure.
legacy_cells.FL: Text tokens and ViT-encoded image tokens enter a multimodal transformer while a VAE encoder forms a structural latent; the shared ocular state S_t=(c_sem,z_struc) conditions a diffusion-based image decoder for parsing, translation, enhancement, and longitudinal OCT forecasting; no planner is described.
legacy_cells.FM: Authors introduce a multimodal generative model with a shared latent ocular state for fine-grained parsing, cross-modality translation, acquisition-robust enhancement, and time-conditioned disease-progression forecasting.
legacy_cells.FN: EyeWorld achieved longitudinal prediction mean LPIPS 0.371, SSIM 0.651, and PSNR 21.462, with reported improvements over the strongest baseline of 2.3%, 6.1%, and 2.278; it also achieved mean segmentation Dice 0.77 versus 0.69 for the strongest baseline.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors report persistent class imbalance; progression evaluation is limited to OCT cohorts and specific diseases and needs broader device, institutional, and pathology validation; progression/counterfactual evaluation uses imaging endpoints and expert labels, without prospective links to visual acuity or treatment response; generative outputs may include changes unsupported by evidence in ambiguous, rare, or underspecified cases.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors call for broader validation across devices, institutions, and pathologies, and prospective longitudinal studies linking predictions to real-world outcomes such as visual acuity changes and treatment response.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors state that ophthalmic AI is predominantly narrow and static, and that a unified multimodal longitudinal world model tailored to ophthalmic disease had not been established.
legacy_cells.FR: The paper demonstrates retrospective image-generation and prediction fidelity, not prospective clinical benefit, treatment-response identification, or decision quality. The prompt-generated 'counterfactual' worsening is not supported by an explicit causal identification method or alternative treatment-action rollouts; the model is described as non-diagnostic and intended for human oversight.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pages 1–38: title/byline (p. 1); abstract (p. 2); introduction (pp. 3–4); Results and Figs. 1–8 (pp. 5–22); Discussion, limitations and conclusion (pp. 23–25); Methods covering ethics, sources, splits, tasks, architecture, training, baselines, metrics and availability (pp. 25–33); references and Extended Data Table 1 (pp. 34–38).
